title: crepidomanes pervenulosum
intro: Crepidomanes pervenulosum, commonly known as the hairy forked spleenwort, is a species of fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. It is native to tropical and subtropical regions of Asia and the Pacific Islands. The hairy forked spleenwort has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
